items.text: the Sound ring's middle is a plain speaker, the name of the ring; touching it while nothing plays starts the sound, as every speaker does
every speaker says the same thing: the bar's and the rings' volume dots show the speaker crossed out when nothing can be heard: sound off, muted, or the volume at zero
with the volume at zero, a tap on any speaker gives the volume back (the last one you had)
the Sound ring's beat level uses the beat symbol you know from the magnet (the bars), not the grid
with the sound off, touching the ring's volume turns the sound on first; then you set how loud
tapping a value dot on a ring (volume, flow, the levels) shows its amount in the dot for a moment; the middle no longer turns into a dial
touchable sound's icon is a finger rising from the bottom through a sound wave
the Sound ring's master keeps in step with the speaker, like Play's volume: lit when heard, dark with the wave when muted, its level round its edge
the Sound ring drops mute (master at zero, or the speaker, mutes)
the tap dot shows the tempo you tapped (120 bpm) and beats with it
a ring button that does something once (dice, back, next, capture) flashes lit as you tap it, and the dice turn over
the bar's speaker wears the volume as a ring round its edge, like the dice's
the ring's volume shows what the speaker shows: lit when you can hear the sound, dark with the wave still moving when it plays muted, its level round its edge
turning a ring dot's second page on or off no longer makes the dot dive behind the middle and pop back
a dot that plays with the sound shows it inside: a thin white ring that swells out from its rim with every sound and fades as it goes; the dot's own edge stays as it was
the Play ring's order: capture on top, still at the top right, the robot at the bottom, volume at the top left
the magnet's pull is the record button's red, its push the dark green; the word stays plain

when the sound is chosen but the browser has not let it play yet (after an update or a fresh launch), the speaker no longer looks on: it waits with a soft outline, the ring's volume dims, and a tap wakes the sound instead of fading it off

the ring lingers when it closes: its dots fold home over about a second (the one you chose stays lit a moment first), then its middle fades over a second and a half; tap the middle while it fades to open the ring again, or its pin to open it pinned
flow on the Play ring reads 0 to 100%, like volume, instead of ×1.5, so the number no longer jumps in width
the Play ring has no mute: volume at zero is mute
